OPUS-MT translation models redistributed by PageWeave (under translate/<source>-<target>/)

Models: Helsinki-NLP OPUS-MT (Language Technology Research Group, University of Helsinki),
licensed CC BY 4.0 (see CC-BY-4.0.txt in this folder). ONNX conversion (int8-quantized encoder
and merged decoder) by Xenova, from the original models; redistributed unmodified apart from
file names (encoder.onnx, decoder.onnx, tokenizer.json, config.json). No endorsement implied.

Citation: Jörg Tiedemann and Santhosh Thottingal. 2020. OPUS-MT — Building open translation
services for the World. Proceedings of the 22nd Annual Conference of the European Association
for Machine Translation (EAMT).
